title: 连接 Lux3D 国内账号
description: 填写与 Lux3D 国内 OpenAPI 共用的 apiKey；WorkBuddy 在本机保存，并在连接时通过 HTTPS 请求头发送。不要在对话中粘贴密钥。
description_en: Enter the same apiKey used for Lux3D China OpenAPI. WorkBuddy stores it on this device and sends it in an HTTPS request header. Do not paste it into chat.
docLabel: 获取 Lux3D 国内 apiKey（与 OpenAPI 相同）
docLabel_en: Get the Lux3D China apiKey used by OpenAPI

fields.label: apiKey
fields.placeholder: 填写在 labs.aholo3d.cn/api-keys 获取的国内 apiKey
fields.placeholder_en: Enter the China apiKey from labs.aholo3d.cn/api-keys
fields.description: 与 Lux3D 国内 OpenAPI 使用同一把 apiKey，无需另行申请 MCP 凭证；不适用于国际账号。
fields.description_en: Use the same apiKey as Lux3D China OpenAPI; no separate MCP credential is needed. International keys are not supported.
